label: late original-phase steps (t=4-7) in sequences starting with m and rich in digits/j/p/b/g/q
explanation: Sparse feature (0.28% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at steps 4-7 (97% of activations, 98% of mass); a little at the delimiter step, never in the copy phase, never at t<3. Position alone is necessary but far from sufficient (precision 1.5%): which steps fire depends on the prefix content. Strongest modulator is first token m (11x lift, 46% of mass; all top examples start with m), then digits (especially 3) and j/p/b/g/q earlier in the prefix, and the current input b/l/j. Activation is highest at steps 5-6 in m-initial sequences containing 3 early (e.g. m j b 3 1 [l]). Best boolean (m-first, steps 4-7, >=3 prefix tokens from {m,3,j,p,b,g,1,2,q}) gets only ~0.3 F1, so the feature looks like a distributed readout of prefix composition, not a clean token rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=m (+6.40), orig0=i (+4.37), prev_tok=1 (+3.60), orig0=j (+3.19), orig2=j (+3.18), orig1=p (+3.18). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-7.46), phase=2 (-4.89), orig_idx=-1 (-4.09), prev_tok=m (-2.97).
